chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Al-Husayn ibn Ali, from Ubeys ibn Hisham, from Thabit, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The one in whose presence I am mentioned, and he forgets to send blessings upon me, Allah causes him to err on the path to Paradise.'
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of forgetting to send blessings upon the Prophet when his name is mentioned?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith underscores the spiritual gravity of neglecting Salawat, framing it not merely as a ritual but as a determinant of one's trajectory toward Paradise. In Shia scholarship, this 'straying' is often interpreted as a subtle deviation in spiritual alignment or a loss of divine favor, reinforcing the Prophet's name as a conduit for mercy. The emphasis on the moment of mention highlights the immediacy required in maintaining this spiritual connection.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Al Husayn Bin Ali, from Ubeys Bin Hisham, from Sabit, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘The one in whose presence Isaww am mentioned, so he forgets that he should be sending Salawāt upon mesaww, Allahazwj would Cause him to err on the road to the Paradise’.
en.sarwar: 20. Abu Ali al-Ash’ari has narrated from al-Husayn ibn Ali from ‘Ubays ibn Hisham from Thabit from abu Basir from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:
“The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘If my name is mentioned before a person and he forgets to ask from Allah al-Salat (favors) for me, Allah will make him lose the way to paradise.’”
